uv: world-scale: u, v = metres / tile_size_m; v runs down the texture = along the grain
grain: down-slope (v): flat-lock sheets 0.25 x 0.50 m, staggered

_w0.name: clean
_w0.look: younger patina: brown copper flecks through the green

_w1.name: normal
_w1.look: full green patina, pale rain runs

_w2.name: heavy
_w2.look: old: chalky pale-green bloom, black run stains

normal_convention: DirectX (green = down), like the library; make_textures.GREEN_DX flips all
note: Aged copper roofing with green patina (dobuki): the richest halls and castle-grade roofs (KEEP_CIVIC: Nagoya / Edo copper keeps). 2 m tile; geometry carries the batten seams (jp_p_roof_sori copper, every 0.45 m), the texture the sheet laps. Replaces W2P2's roof_kureita stand-in.
